description: Direct search and retrieval of a specific statutory rule, time limit, or procedural step.
example_query: What is the stipulated time limit for trade licence renewal under GMC?
expected_workflow: Hybrid Retrieval -> Version Filter -> Provenance Audit -> Answer with Citation
expected_output: Direct factual statement with exact rule number, timeline, authority, and provenance rating.

description: Locating an official enactment, notification, circular, or gazette by title or reference number.
example_query: Find Assam Gazette Extraordinary No. 530 dated 25th October 2024.
required_evidence: Document metadata record & SHA-256 integrity hash
expected_workflow: Metadata Index Search -> Document Metadata Match -> Provenance Audit -> Source Link
expected_output: Document title, reference number, issuing authority, and authenticated link.

description: Synthesizing an extensive statutory rule, manual chapter, or circular into key operational points.
example_query: Summarize the key provisions of the Assam Public Procurement Rules 2020 on tender splitting.
required_evidence: Cleaned semantic chunks of targeted chapter
expected_workflow: Chunk Extraction -> Core Principle Synthesis -> Provenance Trace
expected_output: Structured summary with bullet points, exceptions, and section citations.

description: Drafting an official government notice, acknowledgement, or circular in standard administrative format.
example_query: Draft a notice for notice board display of GMC citizen charter services under Rule 4.
required_evidence: Rule 4 text of ARTPS Rules & Form templates
expected_workflow: Template Retrieval -> Statutory Placeholder Injection -> Human Review Warning
expected_output: Official draft notice adhering to statutory language with review placeholders.

description: Translating statutory rules or public notices between English, Assamese, and Hindi while preserving legal terminology.
example_query: Translate the SC/ST fee exemption clause from English into Assamese.
expected_workflow: Statutory Chunk -> Indic Terminology Mapping -> Verification Check
expected_output: Legally accurate Assamese translation preserving statutory definitions.

description: Extracting tabular data, timelines, fee amounts, or designated officials from an operational charter.
example_query: Extract all user fees and timelines from the GMC Citizen Charter.
expected_workflow: Table Extraction -> Schema Mapping -> Tabular Presentation with Temporal Flag
expected_output: Clean tabular output listing service name, fee, days, and designated servant.

description: Comparing two versions of a statute, or state vs central procurement thresholds.
example_query: Compare the QCBS consultancy evaluation framework in Assam rules versus Central MoF manual.
required_evidence: Evidence chunks from both target documents
expected_workflow: Dual Retrieval -> Provision Alignment -> Jurisdictional Variance Highlighting
expected_output: Comparative table identifying threshold differences, ratios, and jurisdictions.

description: Evaluating whether a candidate or vendor meets statutory criteria.
example_query: Is an officer with 5 years regular service in Level 12 eligible for Registrar in CIC?
expected_workflow: Criteria Extraction -> Condition Matching -> Temporal Validity Gate
expected_output: Clear eligibility determination citing essential experience and conditions.

description: Validating an administrative draft against governing rules for legal discrepancies.
example_query: Check if this draft tender notice complies with Rule 5 of Assam Procurement Rules.
required_evidence: Statutory rule provisions and mandatory clauses
expected_workflow: Draft Parsing -> Rule Clause Comparison -> Defect Flagging
expected_output: Compliance report highlighting compliant clauses and legal defects.

description: Tracing the origin, gazette publication, and institutional authority of an unverified circular.
example_query: Verify whether 'untitled_23.pdf' is an authentic government enactment.
required_evidence: Gazette headers, Governor assent, reference numbers, file hashes
expected_workflow: File Hash Match -> Gazette Imprint Audit -> Signatory Authority Verification -> Anomaly Flag
expected_output: Full provenance audit report identifying true title, Act number, and authenticity status.
